summary: ACCEPT. pmcro-dotnet is installable and carries a skill whose generator was already proven end to end by scaffolding TrailEvent into the runtime and compiling it. The plan for this cycle came from NEXT-SEED.md rather than a fresh Planner pass, which is what that seed exists for. Earned constraint: an integrity manifest must exclude runtime state, because a check that fails during ordinary work is a check people learn to ignore. Next bounded action: the mcp-server-project skill, carrying the archive's three-pillar layout as a dotnet new template in assets/.
